title: Technology Sector Update for 09/24/2018: TEUM,SYMC,MU
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Tech Stocks
MSFT -0.36%
AAPL +1.13%
IBM -1.10%
CSCO -0.02%
GOOG +0.92%
Technology stocks were scratching out small gains on Monday, with the shares of tech stocks in the S&P 500 adding almost 1% in value as the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index was gaining 0.4%.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
(+) Pareteum ( TEUM ) rose 5.7% Monday afternoon, easing from earlier gains that followed the cloud services company saying it received a five-year contract worth an estimated $38 million from an unnamed internet of things and mobile virtual network company. Under the terms of the deal, Pareteum will support the customer's business expansion in southern Asia, including plans to add WiFi, Blockchain, M2M, and Smart City capabilities.
In other sector news:
(+) Symantec ( SYMC ) was 3.6% higher Monday afternoon, giving back a portion of its 6% gain after the cyber-security software firm said it has finished an internal examination and has concluded there is no need for any additional adjustments or restatements of its recent quarterly financial results.
(+) Micron Technology ( MU ) advanced Monday, rising 1.5%, despite Needham & Co cutting its price target for the company by $20 to $80 a share. The brokerage also reiterated its strong buy rating on the stock.
